data.businessDescription: AerCap Holdings NV engages in the leasing, financing, sales, and management of commercial flight equipment. It offers passenger and cargo aircraft. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.

NatWest Group Plc engages in the provision of international banking and financial services. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking, Private Banking, Commercial and Institutional, and Central Items and Other. The Retail Banking segment provides a comprehensive range of banking products and related financial services including current accounts, mortgages, personal unsecured lending, and personal deposits. The Private Banking segment focuses on the private banking and wealth management services to UK-connected high-net-worth individuals. The Commercial and Institutional segment includes expertise and tailored solutions needed by businesses, from entrepreneurs through to large corporate organizations. The Central Items and Other segment refer to the corporate functions, such as treasury, finance, risk management, compliance, legal, communications and human resources. The company was founded on March 25, 1968 and is headquartered in Edinburgh, the United Kingdom.

data.businessDescription: Nova Ljubljanska banka dd engages in the provision of banking and financial services. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking in Slovenia, Corporate and Investment Banking in Slovenia, Strategic Foreign Markets, Financial Markets in Slovenia, Non-Core Members, and Other Activities. The Retail Banking in Slovenia segment includes banking activities with individuals and asset management. The Corporate and Investment Banking in Slovenia segment consists banking operations with key corporate clients; small and medium-sized enterprises; investment banking and custody; and restructuring and workout. The Strategic Foreign Markets segment covers strategic group banks in Serbia, North Macedonia, BiH, Kosovo, and Montenegro. The Financial Markets in Slovenia segment comprises treasury activities and trading in financial instruments. The Non-Core Members refers to the operations of REAM and leasing entities. The Other Activities segment pertains to the business of NLB Cultural Heritage Management Institute. The company was founded on July 27, 1994 and is headquartered in Ljubljana, Slovenia.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Europe, Middle East and Africa Banks

data.businessDescription: Raiffeisen Bank International AG engages in the provision of banking and financial solutions. Its products includes financing, leasing, hedging, trade and export finance, cash management, payment and fund, as well as securities and cards services. It operates through the following segments: Central Europe, Southeastern Europe, Eastern Europe, Group Corporates & Markets, and Corporate Center. The Central Europe encompasses the banking markets in Czech Republic, Hungary and Slovakia. The Southeastern Europe represents banks and leasing companies, as well as capital management and asset management companies and pension funds operating in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Kosovo, Romania and Serbia. The Eastern Europe segment covers banking services for corporate and retail customers in Belarus, Kazakhstan, Russia and Ukraine. The Group Corporates & Markets segment covers operating business booked in Austria. The Corporate Center segment refers to central management functions at the head office and other units. The company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Europe, Middle East and Africa Banks

data.businessDescription: Arion Banki HF is engaged in providing the services to households, corporates, institutions, and investors. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, and Markets. The Retail Banking segment offers services that include deposits and loans, savings, payment cards, pensions, insurance, securities, and funds. The Corporate & Investment Banking segment provides companies and investors with comprehensive financial services that meet the needs of each client, both in Iceland and internationally. The Markets segment consists of asset management and capital markets. The company was founded on October 18, 2008 and is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Europe, Middle East and Africa Banks

data.businessDescription: Zigup Plc engages in the business of hiring of vehicles to other businesses on a non-contract basis. It operates through the following segments: UK&I Rental, Spain Rental, Claims & Services, and Corporate. The UK & I Rental segment refers to the provision of commercial vehicle hire and ancillary services in United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. The Spain Rental segment is involved in providing commercial vehicle hire and ancillary services in Spain. The Claims & Services segment focuses on insurance claims and services part of the group providing a range of mobility solutions. The company was founded on July 2, 1897 and is headquartered in Darlington, the United Kingdom.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Motor Vehicles and Parts Sales and Rental

data.businessDescription: Vienna Insurance Group AG engages in the provision of insurance services in the life, health, and property and casualty areas. It operates through the following geographical segments: Austria, Czech Republic, Poland, Extended CEE, Special Markets, and Group Functions. The Austria segment include Wiener Städtische branches in Slovenia and Italy. The Extended CEE segment covers Albania including Kosovo, Baltic states, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Hungary, Moldova, North Macedonia, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, and Ukraine. The Special Markets segment comprises Germany, Georgia, Liechtenstein, and Turkey. The Group Functions segment consists VIG Holding, VIG Re, Wiener Re, VIG Fund, corporate IT service providers, and intermediate holding companies. The company was founded in 1824 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

Íslandsbanki hf engages in the provision of financial services to households, corporations and professional investors. It operates through the following business segments: Personal Banking, Business Banking, and Corporate & Investment Banking. The Personal Banking segment provides comprehensive financial services to individuals, including lending, savings, and payments. The Business Banking segment provides small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with comprehensive financial services, including ergo, the banks asset financing service. The Corporate & Investment Banking segment provides universal banking services to large companies, municipalities, institutional investors, and affluent individuals. The company was founded in 1875 and it is headquartered in Kopavogur, Iceland.

data.businessDescription: BW Energy Ltd. engages in the exploration, acquisition, development and production of oil and natural gas fields. It holds interests in three hydrocarbon licenses including Dussafu in Gabon, Maromba in Brazil and Kudu in Namibia. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Fossil Fuel Exploration and Production

data.businessDescription: KGHM Polska Miedz SA engages in the exploration of copper, precious metals, and other smelter products. It manages a diversified portfolio of mining assets and smelters, supporting global supply through efficient production processes and advanced technologies. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Lubin, Poland.

OTP Bank Nyrt engages in provision of commercial banking services. The firm operates through the following segments: OTP Core Hungary, Russia, Ukraine, Bulgaria, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, Montenegro, Albania, Moldova, Slovenia, Merkantil Group, Asset Management subsidiaries, other subsidiaries, Corporate Centre. The company was founded on March 1, 1949 and is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary.

data.businessDescription: ageas SA/NV engages in the provision of life and non-life insurance, investments, and real estate services. It operates through the following segments: Belgium, Europe, Asia, Reinsurance, and General Account. The Belgium segment provides AG Insurance targets private individuals as well as small, medium-sized and large companies. The Europe segment consists of the insurance activities of Ageas in Europe, excluding Belgium. The Asia segment is active in a number of countries in Asia. The Reinsurance segment engages in the internal reinsurance under group purchasing and capital management. The General Account segment in the group financing and other holding activities. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

Diös Fastigheter AB engages in the provision of real estate services. It owns retail space and shopping centers. It operates through the following segments: Dalarna, Gävle, Sundsvall, Åre and Östersund, Umeå, Skellefteå, and Luleå. The company was founded on May 22, 2005 and is headquartered in Östersund, Sweden.

Frasers Group Plc is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of sports, premium, and luxury brands. It operates through the following segments: UK Sports, Premium Lifestyle, International, Retail, Property, and Financial Services. The UK Sports segment includes sports retail operations in the UK. The Premium Lifestyle segment refers to the premium and luxury retail businesses. The International segment focuses on sports retail stores. The Property segment represents the freehold property owned and long leasehold holding property companies. The Financial Services segment consists of interest charged on amounts advanced to consumer credit customers. The company was founded by Michael James Wallace Ashley in 1982 and is headquartered in Shirebrook, the United Kingdom.

Jet2 Plc engages in providing package holidays, passenger, and charter aircraft operation services. Its brands include Jet2.com, Jet2holidays, Jet2CityBreaks, Jet2Villas, Indulgent Escapes, and VIBE. The company was founded was founded by Philip Hugh Meeson in 1971 and is headquartered in Leeds, the United Kingdom.

PORR AG engages in the development and construction of real estate properties. It operates through the following segments: AT/CH, DE, PL, CEE, Infrastructure International, and Holding segments. The AT/CH segment covers PORR’s entire responsibility for the home markets of Austria and East Switzerland. The DE segment comprises the majority of PORR’s activities in Germany. The PL segment holds complete responsibility for Poland that focuses on office, industrial, and hotel construction and buildings and facilities for the public sector. The CEE segment is focused on the home markets of the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Romania. The Infrastructure International segment deals with contracts in infrastructure construction and cooperation with local partners. The Holding segment bundles operating areas that are not allocated to the operating segments but are managed by the top management level due to developments that are not in line with the market and other equity interests. The company was founded by Arthur Porr on March 16, 1869 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

NN Group NV is a financial services company, which engages in providing retirement services, pensions, insurance, banking, and investments. Its brands include Nationale-Nederlanden, NN, OHRA, Movir, AZL, BeFrank, ABN AMRO Verzekeringen, and Woonnu. It operates through the following segments: Netherlands Life, Netherlands Non-Life, Insurance Europe, Japan Life, Banking, and Others. The Netherlands Life segment offers group life and individual life insurance products. The Netherlands Non-Life segment covers non-life insurance products such as disability and accident, fire, motor, and transport. The Insurance Europe segment includes life insurance, pension products and non-life insurance and retirement services in the Central and Rest of Europe. The Japan Life segment manages corporate owned life insurance business. The Other segment covers the Japan Closed Block VA, reinsurance, and items related to capital management and the head office. The company was founded in 1845 and is headquartered in The Hague, the Netherlands.

Mota-Engil SGPS SA engages in the provision of construction, engineering, environmental services, transport concessions, energy, and mining. It operates through the following business segments: Africa Engineering and Construction, Environment, Latin America – E&C, Europe – E&C, Capital and Mext. The Africa - E&C segment includes engineering and construction activities. The Environment segment deals with treatment, recovery and collection of urban & international waste. The Latin America - E&C segment focuses on energy generation and sales business in Mexico, concession management and operation business in Mexico and Colombia. The Europe - E&C segment offers activities carried out by the group in Portugal. The Capital segment encompasses with Services, Concessions, Tourism & Mobility in Portugal & Poland. The Mext segment comprises with Innovation and development, real estate, Agroforestry & Mining. The company was founded by Manuel António da Mota on June 29, 1946 and is headquartered in Porto, Portugal.

TP ICAP Group Plc engages in the provision of brokerage and market information services. The firm serves the financial, energy and commodities, institutional services, and data and analytics markets. It operates through the following segments: Global Broking, Energy and Commodities, Liquidnet, and Parameta Solutions. The company was founded in 1868 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Metro Bank Holdings Plc is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services through its subsidiary. Metro Bank is a deposit-taking and lending institution with a focus on retail and small and medium-size commercial customers in the United Kingdom. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
